features.ins: 2026-10-29 to 2026-11-04 institutional net cash / total turnover pct

methods: TWSE ordinary stocks with liquidity and both flow legs; OLS with intercept; train-fold 2%-98% winsorization and train z-score; deterministic 5-fold cross-sectional CV; dependent variable concurrent five-session return.
limitations: Same-window margin and institution flows include contemporary information; model is EX-POST EXPLANATORY, cannot be used to trade at 10/29.
Cross-sectional CV within one market episode is not out-of-time predictive backtest.
No sector or adjustment for corporate actions; no trading claims or calibrated confidence probabilities.
Potential endogeneity, omitted price-discovery drivers and factor differences.
